messages:
Ivy (CS): GreenBench (CUST-16211) canceled on 2026-10-03 mid-billing-cycle. They were charged full-month invoice INV-2026-1015 for $11,000. Customer asks for a prorated refund for unused days (they used service 3 days out of 31). Ticket: https://support.redwood/t/14567
Sam (Sales): Customer escalation from account owner. They said cancellation due to vendor consolidation. They're asking for a direct refund to card plus a small goodwill credit for the churn pain. Can we do prorate + $500 goodwill?
Sophie (Billing): Pulling invoice. INV-2026-1015 posted 2026-10-01, autopay captured $11,000 on 2026-10-02 (PYM-88901). Policy: prorated refunds are allowed but require CFO sign-off for refunds + goodwill >$1k combined. For pure prorate we can handle within billing team up to $2k, but this is larger. Need exact prorate calculation and approval path.
finance-bot: Auto-calc: Monthly charge $11,000, daily rate = 11000/31 = 354.8387 -> unused days = 28 (cancelled after day 3) -> prorated amount = 9,935.89 (rounded). Requested goodwill $500. Total requested refund = 10,435.89.
Ivy (CS): Customer explicitly asked for full refund to the card for the unused period. They indicated bank reconciliation requirements. Account owner asks we expedite if approved.
Sam (Sales): Given ARR and churn risk, recommend full refund (prorated) to card plus $500 account credit instead of refunding goodwill to card — keeps cash lower. If CFO approves, we can refund prorated amount to card and apply $500 as account credit (CM) so customer sees both. Thoughts? @Priya (CFO)
Priya (CFO): Approve split approach: refund prorated amount to card and apply $500 as account credit. Use GLs: 6350 for card refund, 6302 for account credit. Please add memo: "Prorated refund for early termination - INV-2026-1015" and "Goodwill credit for churn mitigation". Also require Sales to note relationship owner in memo. Sophie, proceed and attach all audit refs.
Sophie (Billing): Will do. Calculating precise numbers and rounding per accounting rules (refunds rounded to cents):
```
Monthly charge: 11,000.00
Daily rate: 354.838709677... -> 354.84 (rounded to cents)
Unused days: 28
Prorated refund (pre-round): 28 * 354.838709677 = 9,935.88
Accounting rounding: prorated refund = 9,935.88
Goodwill account credit = 500.00
Total adjustment = 10,435.88
```
Sophie (Billing): Initiating REF-2026-701 to card on file for 9,935.88 (GL 6350) and posting CM-2026-1745 for -500.00 (GL 6302) to apply as account credit. Draft ledger entries: 
```
Date: 2026-10-05
Account: 6350 - Customer Refunds
Customer: CUST-16211 (GreenBench)
Amount: -9,935.88
Memo: Prorated refund for early termination - INV-2026-1015 - Owner: Sam (Sales)
Reference: REF-2026-701

Date: 2026-10-05
Account: 6302 - Customer Credits
Customer: CUST-16211 (GreenBench)
Amount: -500.00
Memo: Goodwill credit for churn mitigation - INV-2026-1015 - Owner: Sam (Sales)
Reference: CM-2026-1745
```
payments-bot: Refund REF-2026-701 queued to payment gateway. ETA 3-5 business days for card refunds. Expedited flag not set.
Sophie (Billing): Posted CM-2026-1745 to AR and queued REF-2026-701. Audit links: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1745 and https://audit.redwood/ref/REF-2026-701 (pending). Notifying CS for customer message.
Sam (Sales): I'll send the customer-facing note: "We've processed a refund of $9,935.88 to your card for unused service days and applied a $500 account credit for inconvenience. Refund will appear in 3-5 business days. Please reach out if you need any further documentation." Adding relationship owner note to CRM.
Ivy (CS): Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate quick handling." They asked for a one-line confirmation for internal finance team; Sam will send transaction IDs when REF clears.
Priya (CFO): Please include this in month-end revenue memo and adjust recognized revenue for pro-rata reversal. Accounting team: expect JE to reverse recognized revenue for the unused period. Marking approval complete.
Sophie (Billing): Posting complete on billing side. Creating ENG ticket ENG-5784 to add a cancel-within-cycle proration flag on invoices so future cancellations auto-calc refunds and optionally block autopay if cancel detected within 5 days of billing cycle. Linking to BT-2026-1102 for monitoring.
finance-bot: ENG-5784 created and linked. BT-2026-1102 monitoring rule added.
Sophie (Billing): Closing loop from billing ops: CM and REF created and queued. Will attach processor trace to audit when REF completes. Thread resolved from finance side. :white_check_mark:
